check_service_status.description: Check whether kanye.rest is answering, and how quickly. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it. Being throttled is reported separately from being down.
check_service_status.name: check_service_status

get_quote_by_id.description: Get one specific quote back, by the id an earlier step reported or by the quote's own text. This is what re-posting a quote you found yesterday needs, and what tells you whether one you stored is still in the catalogue. The service publishes no ids of its own, so the id is Lodol's and is derived from the quote's text.

quote.quote: I love sleep; it's my favorite.
quote.text: I love sleep; it's my favorite.

parameters.description: The quote's id, twelve characters of hex, or the quote's exact text. Usually this comes from an earlier step: every action here returns an 'id' for each quote it hands back.

get_quote_of_the_day.description: Pick one quote for a day and keep picking that same quote all day. A random draw gives a different one on every call, so a daily workflow that retries, or that two people run an hour apart, posts two different quotes for the one day. This one is fixed by the date: the same date always gives the same quote, and tomorrow gives a different one. Add a seed of your own to have two workspaces post different quotes on the same day.

description: Pull Kanye West quotes from kanye.rest, the free 'Kanye as a Service' API. Draw one at random or a batch of them, search every quote for a word, read the whole catalogue, or pick a quote of the day that stays the same all day so a scheduled post never tells two. Every quote comes back with its attribution and a stable id you can store and look up again, neither of which the service itself provides, and the handful of quotes with strong language are left out unless you ask for them.
